items.passageEn: Today is a terrible day for Ben. His bike is broken, so he walks to school. It rains, and his shoes get dirty. At lunch, the cafe is closed. In the test, he can't answer any of the questions, so his paper is blank. At home, his mom makes him a super dinner.
items.passageZh: 今天對 Ben 來說很糟。他的腳踏車壞了，只好走路上學。下雨了，他的鞋子弄髒了。午餐時咖啡店沒開。考試時他一題都答不出來，所以考卷是空白的。回到家，媽媽為他煮了一頓超棒的晚餐。

rubricZh: 「壞了」可用 be broken（例如 is broken）
寫 My bike does not work. 也正確

referenceEn: Don't put dirty clothes on the bed.
Do not put your dirty clothes on the bed.
rubricZh: dirty 放在名詞前（例如 dirty clothes）
否定命令可寫，例如 Don't put…、Please don't put… 等
